method: Local tools/list definitions and synthetic call parameters; no tools executed and no model inference.

definition.name: managedlustre_fs_blob_autoimport_create
definition.description:
Creates a continuous autoimport job that syncs new or modified blobs from the linked hierarchical
storage management (HSM) container to an Azure Managed Lustre filesystem. Configure conflict handling,
imported prefixes, and deletions through the parameters. Returns the job name.

filesystem-name.description: The name of the Azure Managed Lustre filesystem

job-name.description: The name of the autoimport job. If not specified, a timestamped name will be generated.

conflict-resolution-mode.description: How the autoimport job handles conflicts. Fail: stop immediately on conflict. Skip: pass over the conflict. OverwriteIfDirty: delete and re-import if conflicting type, dirty, or currently released. OverwriteAlways: extends OverwriteIfDirty to include releasing restored but not dirty files. Default: Skip.

autoimport-prefixes.description: Array of blob paths/prefixes that get auto imported to the cluster namespace. Default: '/'. Maximum: 100 paths. Example: --autoimport-prefixes /data --autoimport-prefixes /logs

admin-status.description: Whether the autoimport job is active. Defaults to Enable.

enable-deletions.description: Whether to enable deletions during auto import. This only affects overwrite-dirty mode. Default: false.

maximum-errors.description: Total non-conflict-oriented errors (e.g., OS errors) that import will tolerate before exiting with failure. -1: infinite. 0: exit immediately on any error.

subscription.description: The Azure subscription GUID identifier or display name. If not specified, the Azure CLI profile default subscription or AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID environment variable will be used.

tenant.description: The Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID identifier or display name.

annotations.title: Create Azure Managed Lustre Autoimport Job

definition.name: resiliency_recoveryplan_validateforfailover
definition.description: Validates a resilience recoveryplan for failover using customer-provided source locations, selected recovery-resource IDs, or both. If the customer provides neither selector, ask which source locations or recovery-resource IDs to validate; never infer them from prior context or resource metadata. Use this tool to check failover qualification or readiness, identify blocking reasons per recovery resource, or supply user consent. This validation-only operation does not execute failover or update recovery resources.

service-group.description: The name of the service group.

recoveryplan.description: The name of the recoveryplan to validate for failover.

source-locations.description: Customer-provided Azure locations from which resources would fail over, such as eastus or westus2-az3. Provide source locations, selected resource IDs, or both. Do not infer omitted locations; ask the customer.

selected-resource-ids.description: Customer-provided full recovery-resource IDs to validate. Provide selected resource IDs, source locations, or both. Do not infer omitted IDs; ask the customer.

user-consent.description: Optional customer-provided execution consent; do not infer consent.

tenant.description: The Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID identifier or display name.

definition.name: deploy_iac_rules_get
definition.description: Retrieves curated IaC rules and best practices for creating Bicep or Terraform files compatible with Azure Developer CLI (azd) or Azure CLI deployments. Covers Azure resource configuration standards, naming requirements, and deployment tool constraints that differ from generic IaC guidance. Returns a formatted rules document. Specify deployment tool, IaC type, and target resource types.

deployment-tool.description: The CLI whose deployment constraints the rules should follow.

iac-type.description: The type of IaC file used for deployment. Valid values: bicep, terraform. Leave empty ONLY if user wants to use AzCli command script and no IaC file.

resource-types.description: Comma-separated list of Azure resource types to generate rules for. Get the value from context and use the same resources defined in plan. Valid value: 'appservice', 'containerapp', 'function', 'aks', 'azuredatabaseforpostgresql', 'azuredatabaseformysql', 'azuresqldatabase', 'azurecosmosdb', 'azurestorageaccount', 'azurekeyvault'

definition.name: managedlustre_fs_update
definition.description: Update maintenance window and/or root squash settings of an existing Azure Managed Lustre (AMLFS) file system. Provide either maintenance day and time or root squash fields (no-squash-nid-list, squash-uid, squash-gid). Root squash fields must be provided if root squash is not None. In case of maintenance window update, both maintenance day and maintenance time should be provided.

name.description: The AMLFS resource name. Must be DNS-friendly (letters, numbers, hyphens). Example: --name amlfs-001

maintenance-day.description: Preferred day for the maintenance window; requires --maintenance-time.

maintenance-time.description: Preferred maintenance time in UTC. Format: HH:MM (24-hour). Examples: 00:00, 23:00.

root-squash-mode.description: Root squash policy. Non-None modes require --squash-uid, --squash-gid, and --no-squash-nid-list.

no-squash-nid-list.description: Comma-separated list of NIDs (network identifiers) not to squash. Example: '10.0.2.4@tcp;10.0.2.[6-8]@tcp'.

squash-uid.description: Numeric UID to squash root to. Required in case root squash mode is not None. Example: --squash-uid 1000.

squash-gid.description: Numeric GID to squash root to.  Required in case root squash mode is not None. Example: --squash-gid 1000.

subscription.description: The Azure subscription GUID identifier or display name. If not specified, the Azure CLI profile default subscription or AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID environment variable will be used.

tenant.description: The Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID identifier or display name.

definition.name: resiliency_drill_start
definition.description: Starts, runs, or executes a resilience drill in Failover or TestFailover mode. Use this command to begin a new drill execution, not to get or list drill definitions. Returns the operation ID for the accepted asynchronous request.

service-group.description: The name of the service group.

drill.description: The name of the resilience drill to start.

mode.description: Whether to perform a real failover or a test failover.

tenant.description: The Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID identifier or display name.
